name: Media Title Length
description: Lets a site set the maximum length of the media entity name/title field, altering the base field setting and the underlying database column length.
project_description:
Overview 

The Media Title Length provides a feature that allows the webmaster to control and set the media title (name) field length.

 Installation 

The installation of this module is like other Drupal modules, Install the module, and enable it.

 Configuration 

After the installation:

 
 Navigate to administer >> configuration >> media >> media title length settings 
 Set media title length. 
 
 Requirements 

This module requires no modules outside of Drupal core.
